title: RWB-S7-E6024-APP: no source publishes the correction operation or its elements, the loop's owner and time limit that REQ-S7-004 requires are unconfirmed, the retry count has no column, the other two entries to WRITEOFF_EXCEPTION have no feature, and SCR-27 has no exception state
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6024-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-024; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.3, A2.9, A2.12 and Requirements served; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-24, R-WO-41, R-WO-43 and R-WO-44 to R-WO-46 and the States sheet; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-12; Business Requirements Program v4 row REQ-S7-004
description: (1) TSD S7 T-A.1 publishes two operations for the module, POST /write-off-scans (API-S7-001, right C) and POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision (API-S7-002, right A), and the legacy Endpoints table of RWB-E6-024 repeats those same two rows for the exception loop, so the correction decision the loop is worked by has no published path, request element, answer element or error set. (2) REQ-S7-004 requires the loop to have one named owner and a time limit; the routing logic gives the owner as Owner to confirm with C&R and the timer as to confirm with Credit Administration, the States sheet labels WRITEOFF_EXCEPTION as Write-off exception, owner to confirm, and the FSD says of the feature that this loop has no owner today; no source supplies either value. (3) retry_count, the retry limit, the loop's owner and the correction task's service level appear in no write_off column (TSD S7 T3.1 gives eleven fields, DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020) and in no list of values (T3.2 is empty), so no property, column or enumeration can be declared for them. (4) WRITEOFF_EXCEPTION is an exception state with three rules in and three out; only R-WO-24 sits in an FSD feature table of this feature (A2.12, and A2.6), R-WO-44 sits in A2.9, and R-WO-41 and R-WO-43 appear in no feature table, so the other two entries to the state are owned by no feature. (5) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, assignment, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which this service may read or write as a table, and its Endpoints table carries the monolith base. (6) The plan gives H as RWB-S7-E6024-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step consumes four rows and raises a task, and DP-04, DP-05, DP-09, DP-10 and DP-18 are absent from the pattern set although the step evaluates a package, reads no ACE view, raises a kit task and records a decision. (7) The legacy screen table gives SCR-27 the states Scan, proposed, in committee and approved and no exception state, so the screen has no vocabulary for WRITEOFF_EXCEPTION and the state value is taken from the route state instead.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 endpoint inventory of API-S7-001 and API-S7-002, T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without a message id per condition, T3.1 field list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 with no retry count and no state list, the empty T3.2 list table, T4 state machine rows R-WO-22 to R-WO-24, T5.3 single published event and T6.1 RBAC matrix; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-24, R-WO-41, R-WO-43, R-WO-44, R-WO-45 and R-WO-46 and the States sheet row WRITEOFF_EXCEPTION (3 rules in, 3 rules out); FSD S7 A2.9, A2.12.1, A2.12.2, A2.12.3.1, A2.12.3.2, A2.12.3.3 and the Requirements served and Screens tables; legacy RWB-E6-024 Story, Acceptance criteria, Data, Endpoints, Permission checks and Test cases; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6024-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-05, DP-09, DP-10 and DP-18 rows; Business Requirements Program v4 REQ-S7-004
area: Contract surface, rule and reference-data ownership, field definition, state ownership, dependency and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; add the correction operation on the write-off base with a placeholder path and placeholder elements; take the correction vocabulary from the three rule events of the exit and record that no list of values exists; read the retry count from the posting step of the same workflow and the retry limit from the WO package at its version in force, and add no column; raise the correction task through the human-task template of the workflow kit and read the owner and the service level from reference data; carry R-WO-41 and R-WO-43 as the other two entries of the state and raise them as unclaimed by any FSD feature; carry MSG-S7-001 as a message of the set that no path raises; trace to REQ-S7-004 with the owner and the time limit recorded as unconfirmed

title: RWB-S7-E6024-CON: the correction operation, its two elements and the loop's owner and service level have no published baseline, the retry count has no element, and the plan's C row is empty while four rows are consumed
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6024-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, naming rules, Architecture v5 slide 13 connection matrix); legacy RWB-E6-024; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.12; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; API Specification v4 schemas WriteOff and CommitteeDecision; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-24 and R-WO-44 to R-WO-46
description: (1) No source publishes the correction operation, the CorrectionRequest and WriteOffCorrection elements, their property lists or their required lists; TSD S7 T-A.1 gives two operations for the module and T-A.2 gives error codes without a message id per condition. (2) TSD S7 T3.2 is an empty list-of-values table, so the only enumeration the sources give is the event column of R-WO-44, R-WO-45 and R-WO-46, and the published CommitteeDecision enumeration of approve, reject and defer cannot carry a correction. (3) The loop's owner and the correction task's service level have no element, no field id and no owner, although REQ-S7-004 requires both. (4) retry_count and the retry limit have no column in T3.1, no field id and no element, so the contract declares no property for either. (5) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage or raises a case task, and the connection matrix gives row S7 Temporal to P7 and P8 and REST with events to P1 only, so the four consumed rows are declared with placeholders. (6) The plan's C, I and X rows are empty while the contract declares four consumed rows, and DP-09 is absent from the pattern set although the service owns a topic.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 endpoint inventory of two operations with no correction operation, T-A.2 error lists without message ids, T3.1 field list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020, the empty T3.2 list table, T4 state rows R-WO-22 to R-WO-24 and R-WO-44 to R-WO-46, T5.3 single published event and T6.1 RBAC matrix; API Specification v4 schemas WriteOff (eleven properties, five required, three lengths) and CommitteeDecision (approve, reject, defer); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-24 and R-WO-44 to R-WO-46 and the States sheet; context pack connection-matrix row S7 and naming rules; legacy RWB-E6-024 Data, Endpoints, Permission checks and Test cases; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6024-CON with empty H, C, I and X
area: Contract surface, element definition, interface naming and dependency
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the case read, the four move shapes and the task raise as consumed from rwb-case with placeholders, declare the package row as consumed from rwb-decision, declare the correction enumeration as the three rule events only, declare the owner and the service level as reference and rule values and not as properties, and confirm the path and the element names with the solution architect before the tag
